title: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.38095v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool

translated_title: Nemotron 3.5 Super 与 Lightning：面向智能体AI的开源高效专家混合Mamba-Transformer混合架构模型
translated_abstract: 我们推出 Nemotron 3.5 Super 和 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，这是专为推理、长上下文理解和智能体工作负载设计的开源、高效专家混合Mamba-Transformer混合架构模型。Super 是一个总参数量 1200 亿、激活参数量 120 亿的多模态模型，而 Lightning 则是一个较小的总参数量 300 亿、激活参数量 30 亿的文本模型，两者均为高效部署而设计。两款模型都结合了大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练和原生投机解码技术，其中 Super 还进一步融入了印度语系持续预训练和智能体软件工程中期训练。我们开发了一套涵盖监督微调和强化学习（RLVR 与 RLHF）的完整后训练流程，并在 Super 中辅以专门的教师模型训练和多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）。这将 Super 从一个纯文本基础模型转变为一个能够对文本、图像、视频和交互式工具进行推理的多模态智能体。
tldr: Nemotron 3.5 Super 和 Lightning 是两款开源高效的 MoE Mamba-Transformer 混合架构模型，通过大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练和完整的后训练流程，实现了面向智能体工作负载的高效推理、长上下文理解与多模态能力。
en_tdlr: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning are open, efficient MoE Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models that leverage large-scale distillation, long-context training, and a comprehensive post-training pipeline to deliver efficient reasoning and multimodal capabilities for agentic AI workloads.
